description: This Scala source file defines the ArtifactManager class responsible for handling artifact transfer and caching in the Spark SQL Connect client, including methods for adding artifacts, checking cache status, and uploading class files.

classes.name: ArtifactManager
classes.description: Manages artifacts for transfer and caching in Spark SQL Connect client, including methods for adding, caching, and uploading artifacts.

methods.name: registerClassFinder
methods.description: Registers a ClassFinder for dynamically generated classes.

methods.name: addArtifact
methods.description: Adds a single artifact from a file path or URI.

methods.name: parseArtifacts
methods.description: Parses a URI to produce a sequence of Artifact objects, supporting 'file' and 'ivy' schemes.

methods.name: addArtifacts
methods.description: Adds multiple artifacts to the session, with retry logic.

methods.name: addArtifactsImpl
methods.description: Implementation for adding artifacts, handling batching and streaming.

methods.name: isCachedArtifact
methods.description: Checks if an artifact with a given hash is cached on the server.

methods.name: getCachedArtifacts
methods.description: Batch checks which artifacts are cached, returning a set of hashes.

methods.name: cacheArtifact
methods.description: Caches a single blob and returns its hash.

methods.name: cacheArtifacts
methods.description: Caches multiple blobs, batching checks and uploads, returning their hashes.

methods.name: uploadAllClassFileArtifacts
methods.description: Uploads all class file artifacts from registered ClassFinders.

methods.name: addClassDir
methods.description: Adds class files from a directory to the session.

methods.name: addBatchedArtifacts
methods.description: Packages multiple artifacts into a single request and sends it.

methods.name: readNextChunk
methods.description: Reads a chunk of data from an InputStream for streaming.

methods.name: addChunkedArtifact
methods.description: Uploads an artifact in chunks over multiple requests.
